findings.title: Missing Organization Schema for brand identity and authority
findings.evidence: Structured data contains schemas: ['Person'], but lacks an Organization or Corporation entity definition.

suggested_action.summary: Add Schema.org Organization markup with legal name, official logo, founding date, and sameAs links.
suggested_action.remediation_details: Add Organization JSON-LD to <head>: <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Organization", "name": "Brand Name", "url": "https://example.com", "logo": "https://example.com/logo.png"}</script>

findings.title: Missing atomic entity definition statement in introductory section
findings.evidence: Opening 150 words lack a definitive subject-predicate-object identity declaration (e.g. '[Brand] is an automated...').

suggested_action.summary: Add a crisp, one-sentence canonical definition of the brand/product in the hero paragraph.
suggested_action.remediation_details: Structure the opening hero sentence as: '[Brand] is a [category] that [primary benefit] for [target audience].'

findings.title: AI training crawlers restricted in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot)
findings.evidence: Domain blocks foundation model indexing agents: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot.

suggested_action.summary: Review bot governance policy; allow AI search bots while selectively gating model training if desired.
suggested_action.remediation_details:
To permit foundation models to index your public content, update robots.txt:
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

findings.title: Missing XML Sitemap declaration in robots.txt
findings.evidence: No 'Sitemap: https://...' directive discovered in robots.txt.

suggested_action.summary: Declare canonical XML sitemap location at the bottom of robots.txt.

findings.title: Lack of structured Q&A / FAQ format for conversational query matching
findings.evidence: No question-format headings ('How...', 'What...', '?') found on the page. AI searchers frequently match conversational user queries directly to FAQ structures.

suggested_action.summary: Include a dedicated FAQ section addressing common buyer and user queries in direct question-and-answer format.
suggested_action.remediation_details:
Add an FAQ section using natural language question headings (e.g.

How does [Product] integrate with our stack?

...

) to match conversational query patterns in AI search.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList Schema for topical hierarchy
findings.evidence: No BreadcrumbList schema found. Limits AI understanding of site hierarchy and parent category relationships.

suggested_action.summary: Implement BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to explicitly communicate site navigation taxonomy.

findings.title: No /llms.txt file found for direct AI assistant ingestion
findings.evidence: GET https://109pratham77.tech/llms.txt returned HTTP 0. Site does not yet offer a curated markdown index for AI crawlers.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an /llms.txt file at domain root with curated markdown summaries and key technical links.
suggested_action.remediation_details:
Create https://example.com/llms.txt with core project context:
# Project Name
> Concise product summary for LLMs
## Core Capabilities
- Feature A: Details
- Docs: https://example.com/docs

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish Curated /llms.txt Machine Index
proactive_recommendations.impact: Enables emerging AI agents (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude) to ingest documentation and product specs without parsing complex HTML/CSS layouts.
proactive_recommendations.action: Create https://109pratham77.tech/llms.txt containing structured markdown summaries of products, pricing, and API endpoints.

proactive_recommendations.title: Canonical Wikidata & Knowledge Graph Grounding
proactive_recommendations.impact: Eliminates entity ambiguity across foundation models and establishes permanent corporate entity authority in Google Knowledge Graph and Microsoft Satori.
proactive_recommendations.action: Link your organization's official Wikidata item (QID) and Wikipedia entry in the 'sameAs' array of Schema.org Organization JSON-LD.

proactive_recommendations.title: Context-Preserving Landing Experience for AI Referrals
proactive_recommendations.impact: Prevents immediate bounce for users arriving from AI assistant search citations by greeting them with modular, scannable proof points.
proactive_recommendations.action: Ensure key feature and pricing pages display clear breadcrumbs and a 3-second value proposition directly confirming the topic highlighted in AI citations.

proactive_recommendations.title: Proactive FAQ Schema for High-Intent Conversational Queries
proactive_recommendations.impact: Directly feeds question-and-answer pairs into AI search engines, securing featured snippets and conversational citation cards.
proactive_recommendations.action: Deploy Schema.org FAQPage structured data on key product pages answering top customer queries (pricing, integrations, enterprise security).
